The Imam (a.s) then goes on to describe the lofty status of the final messenger of Allah, Prophet Muhammad (s) as well as that of the first Imam, Imam Ali (as). 

The Imam then laments about the tragedies which befell the Family of the Prophet, The Ahlulbayt (a.s) and the absence [occultation] of the 12th Imam (a.s), who would fill the world with justice after countless eras of injustice.

Du’a Nudbah has been deemed authentic by scholars such as Sheikh Abbas Qummi, Allamah Majlisi, Sayed Raziuddin bin Tawoos and many more. This Du’a is highly recommended to be recited on Fridays and the days of Eid.
